name: Options
description: Represents application options in Microsoft PowerPoint.
example:
Sub TogglePasteOptionsButton()

    With Application.Options

        If .DisplayPasteOptions = False Then

            .DisplayPasteOptions = True

        End If

    End With

End Sub

properties.name: DisplayPasteOptions
properties.description: Determines whether Microsoft PowerPoint displays the Paste Options button, which appears directly under newly pasted text. Read/write.
